title: Professional Email Reinstatement Charge for Suspended Subscriptions
content:
Collections desk standing rule. The reinstatement charge of a Professional Email reactivation renewal is Harborline's published flat fee for reactivating a subscription suspended for non-payment. It is read from the calendar days from the suspension date to the day the reactivation renewal is paid:

- 15 days or more carry a reinstatement charge of 20.00 USD;
- from 4 up to 14 days carry 10.00 USD;
- fewer than 4 days carry no reinstatement charge.

The reinstatement charge is never reduced by any rate, and it is added to the rounded renewal component of the reactivation renewal.

| Days from the suspension date to payment | Reinstatement charge |
|---|---|
| 3 | none |
| 4 | 10.00 |
| 14 | 10.00 |
| 15 | 20.00 |

Example (hypothetical): a subscription suspended on 11 May and reactivated on 23 May, 12 days later, carries 10.00.
